convex_phase_history.necessary_condition: Every step must lie between zero and the innovation toward the target. Target is source phase at the stated lag plus one arbitrary fixed circular rotation. Rotation sets are intersected analytically, not sampled or fitted. Gain may vary freely within [0,1] each frame; a cap toward the target only narrows this hull.
convex_phase_history.scope: Necessary conditions use the actual previous bit17, thus grant exact prior state. Only contiguous positive saved-F0 spans. Linear domain uses target modulo tau. Positive lags use future frames and are diagnostic offline controls, not causal playback. Item-level rotations and more permissive independently reset span-level rotations are both reported. This is not an exclusion of higher-order, nonconvex, dynamic-origin or other-input producers; saved positive F0 is not independent PCM voicing.

cumulative_pitch_difference.scope: Physical-time left/right/trapezoidal integration of saved F0 minus saved baseline F0, in Hz; sign+/-1. State resets on absent spectrum/invalid pitch/span boundary. A circular offset is fitted on the first eight frames per span for each model and its no-integral control separately. Saved-bit17 training state is conditional evidence, not PCM production or recovered authoring timing/configuration. Duplicated catalog items are not independent recordings. No commercial trajectories persisted.

scope: Serialized compact resources, analytic necessary-state constraints and conditional cumulative phase candidates. No native authoring/PCM producer, file changes, installed-array exports, original maker identification or whole-host proof. The full VQM/Growl research objective remains unfulfilled.
